key_insight: The paper proposes replacing optimization-dominated statistical fitting with structure-enabled intelligence that embeds mathematical and physical rules into model architectures.
engineering_relevance: For scientific AI, structural priors could improve constraint adherence and out-of-distribution generalization beyond what data fitting alone provides.
method: Frame optimization-driven AI as prone to smoothing and compromise under noisy, conflicting constraints.
Embed mathematical structures and physical mechanisms as architectural priors.
Constrain inference with scientific rules while preserving human oversight in scientific reasoning.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a conceptual proposal but reports no datasets, benchmarks, quantitative results, or experimental validation.
watch_item: Benefits remain unverified in the abstract, and incorrect or overly restrictive structural priors could limit model applicability.
paper_title: From Objective Compromise to Structure-Enabled Intelligence: Reshaping the Scientific Paradigm of AI
